summary: Tested LuminaHR full stack. Backend: 3/3 pytest passed (GET /api/, POST /api/chat SSE with real GPT-5.4 stream + [DONE] terminator, 422 validation). Frontend Playwright e2e covered: landing (3 portal cards), Portail Carrières (2 active offers, apply flow with toast), Portail Agence (gate AGENCE2024, wrong code -> agency-error-message shown, proposal submit r1, back button), admin login (bad password shows login-error-message, good password reaches dashboard), all 13 sidebar links navigate, employee CRUD (add persists after reload -> TestPrenom found), recruitment offer toggle j1 off removes it from public Carrières (2 -> 1), employee (julie) login shows exactly the 5 allowed modules and none of the 8 forbidden ones, chat widget streams a French reply from backend (visible: 'Bonjour ! Comment puis-je vous aider aujourd'hui ?'). Persistence via localStorage confirmed after reload.

issues: Warning React: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' — a11y improvement, add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to Radix DialogContent to silence and improve screen-reader support.

action_items: Optional: add <DialogDescription> (or aria-describedby) to each DialogContent to remove Radix a11y console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/chat inserts the user message and history BEFORE the LLM call; if the stream fails the DB will contain an orphan user message without an assistant reply. Consider wrapping streaming in try/except and persisting assistant content only on success, or logging errors.

server.py: no error handling around LlmChat stream — an exception inside the async generator will surface as a broken SSE stream without a [DONE] terminator, leaving the frontend hanging. Emit an error event and always yield [DONE] in a finally block.
seed_data_creation: Frontend localStorage: added candidate (Test Candidat/test.candidat@example.com to offer j1), agency proposal on r1, TestPrenom TestNom employee, toggled offer j1 off. Backend: TEST_ chat session in Mongo (chat_messages).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend has only 2 endpoints (GET /api/, POST /api/chat SSE). All HR data lives in frontend localStorage keys luminahr_state_v1 and luminahr_users_v1 — clear them to reset seed. Test seeded some data (see seed_data_creation); to fully reset, run localStorage.clear() before re-testing. Chat message elements did not match my generic selector but the reply is visible in DOM under the chat panel — use a more specific selector next time (inspect ChatWidget component). Offer j1 was toggled OFF during the test, so Careers currently shows 1 active offer instead of 2 until toggled back.
